explanation: On every bounded subinterval of [0,∞), f has only finitely many jump discontinuities at integers, with finite one-sided limits. The unit step g has a single jump at x=2, also with finite one-sided limits. Thus both are piecewise continuous. However, h(x)=csc(x) has infinite singularities at x=nπ, including x=0, so it is not piecewise continuous.
